summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个 reward model、2 个 benchmark、2 个 baseline inpainting model；摘要报告多数 reward model 可用于构造偏好数据，但部分不适合做 evaluator；偏好数据在 candidate scaling 和 sample scaling 下趋势一致，单一 reward 会有明显视觉偏置，ensemble 能缓解并提升泛化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Zhejiang University、The University of Tokyo、Tsinghua University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper re-examines preference alignment for image inpainting, asking whether public reward models provide reliable preference data and whether they induce reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical study of multimodal generative alignment rather than a new generator. Its useful signal for LLM researchers is the measurement of reward quality, reward bias, scaling of preference data, and reward ensembling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study applies Direct Preference Optimization, constructs preference data from nine public reward models, and evaluates two inpainting benchmarks with two baseline models that differ in architecture and generation mechanism. It separates reward models as training-signal providers from reward models as evaluators.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span nine reward models, two benchmarks, and two inpainting baselines. The abstract reports that most reward models give usable preference signals, some fail as evaluators, candidate/sample scaling trends are consistent, and ensemble rewards mitigate brightness, composition, and color-scheme biases.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, The University of Tokyo, and Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward bias 与 ensemble 部分；图像修复结论不能外推到 LLM，但 reward-as-data 和 reward-as-evaluator 的拆分有用。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward-bias and ensemble analysis; inpainting results do not transfer directly to LLMs, but the reward-as-data versus reward-as-evaluator split is useful.

paper.title: HARVE: Hacking-Aware Reward-Head Vector Editing for Robust Reward Models
paper.abstract: Reward models are central to large language model (LLM) alignment, but they remain vulnerable to reward hacking. To evaluate reward-model robustness, we introduce RewardHackBench containing 13 reward-hacking patterns covering real life high-stakes domains and general settings, and we find severe failures on specific subcategories across eight reward models. To mitigate these failures, we propose HARVE, a training-free reward-head editing method for scalar reward models. Instead of fine-tuning th

summary.core_problem: 奖励模型（Reward Model）容易被 reward hacking 攻击——模型利用与奖励相关的表面线索（如长度、文风）来获得高分，而不真正提升事实正确性或推理质量。现有 benchmark 对法律/合规等高风险专业领域的 reward hacking 覆盖不足，且现有缓解方法依赖微调，成本高且难以快速应对新攻击模式。
summary.importance: 构建了首个覆盖法律/政策/合规专业领域的 reward hacking benchmark（RewardHackBench），并提出了一种无需训练的奖励头向量编辑方法（HARVE），通过识别并移除 reward head 向量在 hacking 子空间上的分量来提升鲁棒性，为奖励模型的安全对齐提供了轻量、可解释的干预手段。
summary.technical_approach: (1) RewardHackBench：1,203 对 gold-hacked 匹配样本，覆盖 13 个子类别，分为 5 大类（表面形式模仿、错误推理、谄媚攻击、离题攻击、重风格轻内容）。专业领域部分由纽约州执业律师起草/修订，经 3 名美国法学院学生审核，hacked/gold 词数比均值 1.01 以控制长度混淆。(2) HARVE：从选定 hacking 子类别的残差流方向中识别多维 hacking 子空间，移除 reward head 向量 w_r 在该子空间上的分量。无需梯度更新或微调，仅需少量对比样本。
summary.experiments: 评测 8 个开源 scalar reward 模型（0.6B-20B 参数）。基线结果显示所有模型在至少一个子类别上表现平庸，部分模型在特定攻击下低于随机水平（如 GRM-Llama-3.2-3B 在 Hedge Stripping 上仅 21.43%）。HARVE 在 RewardHackBench 上达到最优性能，目标子类别的 gold-preference rate 比原始 reward 模型提升 21.1 个百分点，比微调基线提升 13.7 个百分点；在非目标子类别上基本保持性能，RM-Bench 上提升 2.4 个百分点。消融实验表明编辑的方向捕捉了超越字面长度的表达模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 §3 的 HARVE 算法细节（子空间识别方法、向量编辑公式）和 §2 的 benchmark 构建方法论（专业领域的人-LLM 协作构建流程）。表 1 的 baseline 评测结果和 §4 的消融实验值得关注。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者及机构信息未在提供的内容中明确列出。

summary_en.core_problem: Reward models are vulnerable to reward hacking — models exploit surface-level reward-correlated cues (length, style) for high scores without improving factual correctness or reasoning quality. Existing benchmarks undercover high-stakes professional domains (law, compliance), and current mitigation methods rely on fine-tuning, which is costly and hard to iterate as new hacking patterns emerge.
summary_en.importance: Presents RewardHackBench, the first reward-hacking benchmark covering professional domains (law/policy/compliance), and HARVE, a training-free reward-head vector editing method that identifies and removes the hacking subspace component from the reward head vector. Provides a lightweight, interpretable intervention for reward model robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: (1) RewardHackBench: 1,203 matched gold-hacked pairs across 13 subcategories in 5 groups (Surface-Form Mimicry, Broken Reasoning, Sycophantic Hacking, Off-Topic Hacking, Style-Over-Substance). Professional-domain portion drafted/revised by New York Bar-admitted attorneys, reviewed by 3 U.S. law students, with mean hacked-to-gold word-count ratio of 1.01 to control length confounds. (2) HARVE: identifies a multi-directional hacking subspace from residual-stream directions of selected hacking subcategories, then removes the component of the reward-head vector w_r aligned with that subspace. No gradient updates or fine-tuning required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 open-source scalar reward models (0.6B-20B params). Baseline results show every model has at least one mediocre subcategory, with some performing below chance on specific attacks (e.g., GRM-Llama-3.2-3B at 21.43% on Hedge Stripping). HARVE achieves the best RewardHackBench performance: +21.1pp gold-preference rate over the original reward model and +13.7pp over the fine-tuning baseline on target subcategories; largely preserves non-target subcategory performance and gains +2.4pp on RM-Bench. Ablations confirm edited directions capture presentation patterns beyond literal length.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 for HARVE algorithm details (subspace identification, vector editing formula) and §2 for benchmark construction methodology (human-LLM pipeline for professional domains). Table 1 baseline evaluation and §4 ablations are key. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly provided in the available content.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 benchmark taxonomy 和 head-edit 公式；结论别外推到 RL 训练闭环前。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark taxonomy and the reward-head edit; do not extrapolate the result to full RL loops without closed-loop evidence.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: When RLHF Fails: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Reward Hacking, Collapse, and Evaluator Gaming
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) makes large-scale post-training possible by replacing an underspecified human objective with learned and scalable proxies. The same substitution creates a structured failure surface: optimization can raise the learned reward while external quality falls, degrade both proxy and judge scores, reveal proxy under-alignment, or produce evaluator-specific disagreement. We present an empirical failure-mode study of a compact RLHF pipeline with proximal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是提出新的 RLHF 算法，而是把 RLHF 训练失败这件事拆细。作者认为“reward hacking”这个词过于粗糙，掩盖了几种机制不同的失败：代理奖励上升但外部质量下降、代理和外部评估一起下降、代理本身就没学对、模型几乎不动、以及不同 judge 给出相反结论。论文试图给这些现象建立一个可审计、可复现的 checkpoint-level 与 prompt-level taxonomy。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为它不涉及 pretrain recipe、数据或优化器创新；但对 post-train 诊断和 pretrain↔post-train 闭环有启发。价值在于两点。第一，它提醒人不要把 RLHF 失败都归因于 reward hacking，很多时候是 collapse、under-alignment 或 evaluator disagreement。第二，它强调 row-level transition 分析，而不是只看 checkpoint 平均分。这种诊断思路对研究训练动态、奖励信号质量、以及 judge 可靠性都有帮助。贡献量级更接近诊断框架和实验方法学，而不是新的训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者构建了一个小规模但完整的 RLHF pipeline：SFT 起点、reward model、PPO 若干 KL 设置、DPO 评估、UP-PPO 变体、reward uncertainty via MC dropout、近似 KL 漂移、diversity/repetition 指标，以及两个外部 LLM judges。核心不是这些组件本身，而是如何定义 failure taxonomy。

论文把分析单位设为 transition，而不是单个 checkpoint。对每个 prompt，比较两个 checkpoint 之间代理奖励 Rφ、主 judge 分数 R†、第二 judge 分数 R2† 的变化方向。主 judge 的方向决定主类别，第二 judge 用来标记 evaluator disagreement。由此把转移分成 stable alignment、reward hacking、optimization collapse、proxy under-alignment、conservative stagnation、evaluator gaming 等类型。这个设计的好处是：它不把不同失败混在一个平均数里，而是能定位“哪一类 prompt 在哪一段训练中开始坏掉”。

作者还尝试做 early-warning：只用转移前的信号去预测后续会不会进入某类失败。可用特征包括 reward uncertainty、近似 policy drift、重复度、多样性等。UP-PPO 在这里不是新架构，而是 shaped-reward PPO：在计算标量 advantage 前，从 reward model 分数里减去 uncertainty penalty。论文把 mitigation 和 diagnosis 分开处理，没有把 UP-PPO 包装成通用解法。
summary.experiments:
实验建立在 GPT-2 量级策略模型和 Anthropic HH-RLHF prompts 上，重点看不同 PPO 强度、DPO、以及 UP-PPO 的失败分布。论文给出的一个明确数字是：aggressive PPO 条件下，256 个 row-level transitions 中有 37 个被判为 reward hacking，占 14.45%；β=0.03 的 PPO 也有 9.38% 的 reward-hacking 占比。作者强调，很多 failure 只有在 row-level 才看得见，checkpoint 平均分会把局部坏例子冲淡。

另一个关键结果是 judge disagreement 被单独当成 failure mode，而不是评测噪声。也就是说，同一训练转移可能在一个 judge 看来是改进，在另一个 judge 看来是退化，这会影响对“是否 reward hacking”的判定。UP-PPO 相比 aggressive PPO 往往更保守，能减少一部分明显失败，但论文没有声称它系统性解决了所有问题。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数值，这里不补写未出现的具体指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Failure-Mode Taxonomy，弄清作者为什么坚持用 transition-based、row-level 的分类，而不是 checkpoint aggregate。然后看 Experimental Design，确认 pipeline 的边界：小模型、HH-RLHF、两个 LLM judges、UP-PPO 只是 uncertainty-penalized reward shaping。最后看 Results 里 taxonomy 统计表和若干 prompt-level case study。预计 25–35 分钟。

阅读时要带着两个问题：第一，taxonomy 是否足够稳健，还是高度依赖 judge 和阈值设定；第二，这套诊断在更大模型、更强 reward model、或 reasoning-heavy RL setting 下是否仍然成立。若只关心方法启发，重点看 row-level localization 和 two-judge disagreement 这两部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not proposing a new RLHF algorithm. Its main goal is to decompose RLHF failure into a more precise taxonomy. The authors argue that the term 'reward hacking' is too coarse: a run where proxy reward rises while external quality falls is different from one where both collapse, different again from a run where the proxy is under-aligned from the start, and different from evaluator-specific disagreement. The paper tries to make these distinctions explicit at both checkpoint and prompt-transition levels.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, since it does not change pretraining recipes, data, or optimization. Still, it is useful for the post-training side of the loop and for understanding training signal quality. The main value is methodological. First, it separates several failure mechanisms that are often conflated under the label of reward hacking. Second, it shows that row-level transition analysis can reveal localized failures that disappear under checkpoint averages. That is useful for anyone studying RLHF dynamics, judge reliability, or reward-model overoptimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental setup is a compact but fairly complete RLHF pipeline: an SFT starting point, a learned reward model, PPO with different KL settings, DPO evaluations, uncertainty-penalized PPO, reward uncertainty estimated via Monte Carlo dropout, approximate KL drift, and lexical diversity and repetition diagnostics, plus two external LLM judges. The novelty is not in these ingredients individually, but in how they are used to define a failure taxonomy.

The key design choice is to classify transitions rather than isolated checkpoints. For each prompt, the paper compares the change in proxy reward R_phi, primary judge score R_dagger, and secondary judge score R_dagger_2 between two checkpoints. The direction of the primary judge defines the main class, while the second judge is used to detect evaluator disagreement. This yields categories such as stable alignment, reward hacking, optimization collapse, proxy under-alignment, conservative stagnation, and evaluator gaming. The benefit is that it localizes where and when failure begins, instead of averaging everything into a single checkpoint score.

The paper also explores early-warning prediction using only pre-transition signals, including reward uncertainty, approximate policy drift, repetition, and diversity. UP-PPO is treated carefully: it is not a new architecture, only a shaped-reward PPO variant where uncertainty is subtracted from the reward before computing the scalar advantage. The paper keeps mitigation separate from diagnosis, which is the right framing here.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use GPT-2-scale policies and Anthropic HH-RLHF prompts. The focus is on how different PPO regimes, DPO evaluation, and UP-PPO distribute across failure categories. One explicit result reported in the text is that aggressive PPO produces 37 reward-hacking transitions out of 256 row-level transitions, or 14.45%. PPO with beta = 0.03 still shows a non-trivial reward-hacking share of 9.38%.

A central empirical point is that many failures are visible only at the row level. Checkpoint averages can hide localized degradation on specific prompts. Another important result is that judge disagreement is treated as a first-class failure mode rather than mere evaluation noise. A transition can look like improvement under one judge and degradation under another, which changes how one should interpret apparent reward hacking. UP-PPO appears more conservative than aggressive PPO and reduces some obvious failures, but the paper does not claim that it solves the problem in a general sense. The provided excerpt does not include the full set of tables and metrics, so no additional numbers should be invented.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the taxonomy section to understand why the authors insist on transition-based, row-level classification instead of checkpoint-level aggregates. Then read the experimental design carefully to keep the scope in view: small models, HH-RLHF prompts, two LLM judges, and UP-PPO as uncertainty-penalized reward shaping rather than a new RL method. Finish with the taxonomy tables and a few prompt-level case studies. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, how robust is the taxonomy to judge choice and threshold settings? Second, would the same categories remain informative at larger scale, with stronger reward models and reasoning-heavy RL setups? If you only want the main methodological takeaway, focus on row-level localization and two-judge disagreement.

recommendation.zh: 读 taxonomy 和 transition 定义即可；setup 偏小，但能校准“RL 信号=质量”的天真假设。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and transition definitions; the setup is small, but it usefully weakens the naive ‘RL signal equals quality’ prior.

paper.title: Are we really tilting? The mechanics of reward guidance in flow and diffusion models
paper.abstract: Reward guidance algorithms steer a learned generative process toward the reward-tilted measure at inference time. While empirically powerful, these methods are prone to reward hacking: the guided model over-optimizes the reward at the cost of fidelity to the learned distribution. Prior work has attributed this to the complexity of neural reward functions or implicit biases in diffusion training, but its fundamental origins remain poorly understood. We show that reward hacking arises from an appr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 reward-guided flow / diffusion 为什么没有真正采到 reward-tilted distribution，而是经常出现 reward hacking。核心结论是：问题不一定来自复杂 reward 模型或 diffusion 训练偏差，有限粒子的 Doob h-function plug-in 估计本身就会引入系统性偏差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在 LLM 训练 recipe，而在“用奖励信号改写生成分布”的机制理解。它把 reward guidance 中的 reward hacking 拆成可分析的统计误差问题，说明即使基础分布、reward、动力学都很简单，近似的 guidance 也会把样本推向错误区域。这对 diffusion LM、flow-based LM、RL-style generation、best-of-n sampling、test-time search 都有启发：奖励信号的使用方式可能比 reward 模型本身更早地产生偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 stochastic interpolants 和 Doob h-transform 出发。理想情况下，若已知 h_t(x)=E[exp(lambda r(X_1)) | X_t=x]，就可以通过修改 drift，使终端分布精确变成 rho_1(x) exp(lambda r(x)) 归一化后的 reward tilt。实际方法通常无法计算这个条件期望，只能从 p(X_1 | X_t=x) 采 k 个粒子，用有限样本平均近似 h_t。论文分析的重点就是这个 plug-in estimator。作者在 Gaussian 和 Gaussian mixture 目标上做闭式分析，分离出两个失败模式：在单个 mode 内，有限粒子估计会导致过度集中和均值 overshoot；在多 mode 情况下，局部条件采样很难发现远处高 reward mode，因此 guidance 缺少正确重加权不同 mode 的机制。为缓解第一个问题，论文提出一个闭式的 damped reward schedule lambda_t，降低后期 guidance 的过强拉动；为处理 mode selection，论文解释 best-of-n 的作用不是修正 drift，而是通过多次采样增加命中高 reward mode 的机会。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gaussian mixture、二维 checkerboard 和 FLUX.1 文生图。Gaussian / Gaussian mixture 部分用于验证理论预测：普通 plug-in guidance 会在 mode 内过度优化 reward，并且不能可靠选择远距离高 reward mode；damped lambda_t 能减轻 within-mode reward hacking；best-of-n 更接近承担跨 mode 选择的角色。FLUX.1 实验用于展示这个机制在实际 text-to-image guidance 中也有可见影响：单纯增大 guidance scale 会提高 reward 指标但损伤 fidelity，而 damping 加 best-of-n 可以在 reward 和样本质量之间给出更稳的折中。提供的正文片段没有给出完整数值表，适合把实验作为机制验证而非最终性能比较来读。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 Background 中 Doob h-transform 和有限粒子 h-function 估计的定义，然后看 Gaussian 与 Gaussian mixture 的闭式推导。图 2 是理解整篇论文的入口：base target、analytic reward tilting、practical guidance、damping + best-of-n 的对比很清楚。实验部分优先看 Gaussian mixture 和 FLUX.1，关注 damping schedule 改的是什么、best-of-n 没有改什么。若关心 diffusion LM 或 RL-guided generation，可以深挖它对“奖励倾斜分布”和“实际采样分布”差距的刻画。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why reward-guided flow and diffusion models often fail to sample from the intended reward-tilted distribution and instead show reward hacking. Its main point is that the failure can arise from the finite-particle plug-in approximation of the Doob h-function, even in simple Gaussian settings.
summary_en.importance: The value for foundation-model pretraining research is conceptual rather than recipe-level. It gives a clean mechanism for how reward signals distort a generative distribution when the guidance estimator is biased. This matters for diffusion language models, flow-based language models, RL-guided generation, best-of-n sampling, and test-time search: the approximation used to inject reward can introduce distributional errors before one even considers neural reward-model misspecification.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis is built around stochastic interpolants and the Doob h-transform. If h_t(x)=E[exp(lambda r(X_1)) | X_t=x] were available, modifying the drift by the corresponding h-transform would produce exact samples from the reward-tilted terminal law. Practical methods approximate h_t with k samples from the conditional endpoint distribution p(X_1 | X_t=x). The paper studies this plug-in estimator directly. In Gaussian targets, it derives how finite-particle estimation causes within-mode overconcentration and mean overshoot. In Gaussian mixtures, it shows that local conditional sampling has no reliable mechanism for reweighting distant high-reward modes. The proposed mitigation is a closed-form damped reward schedule lambda_t for reducing within-mode over-optimization, while best-of-n sampling is interpreted as a separate mechanism for mode selection rather than as a fix to the drift estimator.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section uses Gaussian mixtures, a 2D checkerboard distribution, and FLUX.1 text-to-image generation. The synthetic experiments validate the predicted failure modes: standard plug-in guidance over-optimizes reward within a mode and struggles to select far-away high-reward modes. The damped schedule reduces within-mode reward hacking, while best-of-n mainly improves the chance of finding a better mode. The FLUX.1 experiments show the same tradeoff in a realistic generator: increasing guidance can raise reward metrics while reducing fidelity, and damping plus best-of-n gives a more controlled tradeoff. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so the results are best read as mechanistic evidence rather than as a leaderboard-style comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the background on the Doob h-transform and the finite-particle h-function estimator. Then read the closed-form Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture analyses, since that is where the main contribution lies. Figure 2 is the fastest way to understand the contrast between analytic tilting, practical guidance, and the proposed damping plus best-of-n strategy. For readers working on diffusion LMs or reward-guided generation, the useful part is the gap between the ideal tilted law and the actual sampling law induced by estimator bias.

recommendation.zh: 核心结论清晰解释了奖励引导的reward hacking根源，阻尼策略可直接复现用于diffusion LM的推理引导消融实验
recommendation.en: Its core conclusions clearly explain the root of reward hacking in reward guidance; the damping schedule can be directly reproduced for diffusion LM inference guidance ablation experiments

paper.title: Isolating LLM Lexical Bias: A Curation-Free Triangulated Metric for Preference-Stage Learning

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖人工词表/启发式筛选的前提下，规模化地“定位并量化”偏好学习阶段（RLHF/DPO 等）引入的词汇层面偏移（lexical bias），并把这种偏移与 base model 本身的分布差异区分开，从而支持训练阶段归因。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain 研究的直接价值不在于改训练 recipe，而在于提供一个更可复用的诊断量表：把“人类文本 vs base 生成 vs instruct/偏好后生成”三者放在同一坐标系里，减少以往靠手工挑词（如 delve/furthermore）导致的选择偏差。它更像是 post-train 质量与副作用的可观测指标，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环有用：当你做 mid-train、continual pretrain、或不同偏好算法/数据配比的对照时，TPS 可以作为风格漂移/词汇过拟合的一个稳定读数，用来做 ablation 和回归测试。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是一个“三角测量”的词汇偏移度量 Triangulated Preference Shift (TPS)。数据构造采用 cloze 式切分：对每条 PubMed abstract 在句边界附近一分为二，前半作为 prompt r_i；后半作为人类 gold（H 流）。对同一 prompt，用 base 模型生成得到 B 流，用 instruction/对齐后模型生成得到 I 流。然后在统一预处理与窗口化后，对比词/词形（文中强调 lexical distribution）在 H、B、I 三个流中的相对频率，TPS 旨在捕捉一种特定模式：某词在 I 中的过度代表性，是否更像是“偏好阶段引入的偏移”，而不是 base 模型本来就偏、或只是向人类分布靠拢。方法上刻意避免：1）先验人工词表；2）只做 H vs I 的二元比较（那会把 base 的偏差误归因给偏好阶段）。实现上还强调可复现：全程 greedy decoding (T=0)、禁用采样与 top-k/top-p，固定随机种子；并通过窗口化把长文本切到可比的局部统计单元，降低长度与位置效应。
summary.experiments: 实验设置：42,000 篇 PubMed abstracts（2012–2021，每年 4,200 篇），对 6 个模型家族各取 base+instruct 变体：Falcon-3 7B、Gemma-3 4B、Llama-3.1 8B、Mistral 7B、OLMo-2 7B、Yi-1.5 6B。总生成约 63.4M tokens；经窗口化后，每个模型变体覆盖约 2M tokens 用于统计。论文在验证部分展示 TPS 能在“科学英语 register 相关词汇”上复现并量化 instruct 相对 base 的词汇偏移，并用案例（文中提到 Figure 1、Section 5）说明哪些词更像是偏好阶段诱导的过用，而不是人类语料本身的高频词。就你给的全文片段，尚未出现更细的数值型主结果（例如 TPS 与人工词表命中率、跨模型相关系数、或显著性检验的具体数），但实验规模与对照结构（H/B/I 三流、六家族）是完整的。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（~25–35 分钟）：
1）先看 Section 3（尤其 3.2 解码与预处理、3.3 windowing）理解统计口径，否则 TPS 的可比性会被误解。
2）再看 Section 4.1 的验证：它回答“TPS 是否真的在测偏好阶段偏移，而不是测别的”。
3）重点看 Section 5 + Figure 1：这是把指标落到具体词汇/语域现象上的地方。
4）最后扫 Section 6：作者讨论如何把 TPS 用在受控的偏好训练 ablation（这部分对做训练的人更实用）。阅读时建议带着两个问题：TPS 对长度/重复/模板化输出是否鲁棒；以及当 instruct 模型确实更接近 H 分布时，TPS 如何避免把“对齐成功”误判为“偏差”。

summary_en.core_problem: How to quantify lexical shifts that arise specifically during the preference-learning stage (e.g., RLHF/DPO) without relying on manually curated word lists, while cleanly separating them from (1) the base model’s own lexical biases and (2) genuine movement toward human lexical usage.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a diagnostics contribution rather than a new pretraining recipe. The practical value is a reusable, curation-free metric that can be plugged into post-training ablations and pretrain↔posttrain iteration loops: when you change preference algorithms, preference data mixtures, mid-training/cooldown strategies, or do continual pretraining after alignment, TPS can serve as a regression signal for style/lexicon drift and lexical overfitting artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: They build a three-stream comparison setup: Human continuation (H), base-model continuation (B), and instruction-/preference-trained continuation (I), all generated from the same prompts. Prompts come from splitting PubMed abstracts into two halves at a sentence boundary near the midpoint: first half is the prompt, second half is the human gold continuation. For each prompt, they generate B and I with deterministic greedy decoding (T=0, no sampling/top-k/top-p) and standardized preprocessing. The Triangulated Preference Shift (TPS) score is then computed from lexical frequency distributions across H/B/I, designed to flag tokens/words that become overrepresented in I in a way consistent with a preference-stage-induced shift, rather than being inherited from B or simply reflecting human frequency. A key design choice is triangulation: avoiding the common pitfall of only comparing I vs H (which confounds base-model bias with preference-stage effects). Windowing is used to normalize comparisons and reduce length/position effects.
summary_en.experiments: Dataset: 42k PubMed abstracts from 2012–2021 (4.2k/year). Model families: Falcon-3 (7B), Gemma-3 (4B), Llama-3.1 (8B), Mistral (7B), OLMo-2 (7B), Yi-1.5 (6B), each with base + instruction-tuned variants. Total generations: ~63.4M tokens; after windowing, ~2M tokens coverage per model variant for lexical statistics. The paper validates TPS (Section 4.1) and demonstrates it on register-linked scientific vocabulary (Section 5, Figure 1), showing systematic lexical overuse patterns emerging in instruction-following models relative to both human text and base generations. In the provided full-text excerpt, detailed numeric effect sizes (e.g., correlations, significance tests, or aggregate TPS deltas) are not visible, but the experimental scaffold and scale are clear.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 min):
- Methods first: Section 3.2 (decoding/preprocessing) and 3.3 (windowing), because TPS is only meaningful under a stable counting protocol.
- Then Section 4.1 for the validation logic: does TPS actually isolate preference-stage effects?
- Section 5 + Figure 1 for concrete lexical phenomena and how the metric behaves on real vocabulary.
- Finally Section 6 for how they envision controlled preference-training ablations. While reading, sanity-check robustness to templated outputs, repetition, and length effects, and how TPS distinguishes “alignment toward human usage” from “preference-induced stylistic artifacts.”

recommendation.zh: 建议扫指标定义与验证实验：如果它能在不做人工策展的前提下稳定抓到“关键词投机”，这比又一个 DPO 变体更实用；否则可能只是换皮的扰动一致性分数。
recommendation.en: Skim the metric definition + validation: if it reliably detects keyword gaming without manual curation, it’s more useful than yet another DPO variant; otherwise it’s likely a repackaged perturbation-consistency score.

paper.title: Automating Formal Verification with Reinforcement Learning and Recursive Inference
paper.abstract: Automated formal verification remains challenging for large language models because data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages is scarce, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible code. This thesis studies how verifier environments can improve LLM generation of verified programs and proofs through reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) and verifier-guided inference-time search. First, we train ope

summary.core_problem: LLM 在形式化验证任务（如生成可验证程序和证明）中面临两大瓶颈：证明助手和验证感知语言的训练数据稀缺，且正确性取决于满足精确的机器可检查规范，而非生成看似合理的代码。
summary.importance: 形式化验证是保证软件在所有可能输入下行为正确的数学证明方法，对AI时代的网络安全至关重要。将RL与形式化验证结合，有望大幅降低形式化验证的专家人力成本，对代码生成和安全领域有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出通过 verifier 环境来提升 LLM 生成可验证程序的能力，核心方案包括：（1）基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），使用 GRPO 及其变体；（2）verifier 引导的推理时搜索。具体做法是在 Dafny 语言中训练开源模型，将生成的候选片段组装成完整程序，并用编译器和 verifier 的结果作为奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 仅提供了初步实验摘要：在一个由 APPS 数据集派生的 Dafny 数据集上的初始实验将 verified reward 从 2 提高（具体对比基准未详述）。
summary.reading_guide: 这是一篇博士论文的开篇章节，提供的全文仅包含背景介绍（网络安全风险、形式化验证概述）。核心技术方法和实验细节应在后续章节。建议先看摘要和相关工作部分（未提供），再重点阅读实验章节。预计完整阅读需 30-45 分钟（完整论文）。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供的片段中确定机构和作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs face two major bottlenecks in formal verification tasks (generating verified programs and proofs): scarce training data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible-looking code.
summary_en.importance: Formal verification mathematically proves software behaves correctly on all possible inputs, which is critical for cybersecurity in the AI era. Combining RL with formal verification could substantially reduce the expert labor cost of formal verification, with practical value for code generation and security.
summary_en.technical_approach: The thesis proposes using verifier environments to improve LLM generation of verifiable programs. Core schemes include: (1) Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) using GRPO and variants; (2) Verifier-guided inference-time search. Specifically, open-source models are trained in the Dafny language, generated candidates are assembled into complete programs, and compiler/verifier outcomes serve as reward signals.
summary_en.experiments: Only preliminary experiments are summarized: initial experiments on an APPS-derived Dafny dataset increased verified reward from 2 (baseline details not fully provided).
summary_en.reading_guide: This is the opening chapters of a PhD thesis. The provided content only covers background (cybersecurity risks, formal verification overview). Core methodology and experimental details should be in subsequent chapters. Suggest reading the abstract and related work first (not provided), then focus on the experimental chapters. Estimated 30-45 minutes for the complete thesis.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information cannot be determined from the provided fragments.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward-hacking 部分即可；它提醒 RLVR 的瓶颈常在规格质量，不在优化器名字。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-hacking part; it is a useful reminder that RLVR often fails on spec quality, not optimizer branding.

paper.title: Improving Small Language Models for Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning from Verification Feedback
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models using programmatically checkable signals such as unit-test outcomes, enabling direct optimization for functional correctness in code generation. We conduct an empirical study of RLVR for Python code generation on the MBPP benchmark using two small models (Qwen3-0.6B and Llama3.2-1B) with LoRA fine-tuning. Across multiple reward formulations such as: unit-test-only rewards, static-analysis-only shaping via the Ruff linte

summary.core_problem: 在代码生成的 RL 训练中，如何设计可验证奖励（RLVR）以提升模型的功能正确性，同时避免模型为了迎合单一奖励信号（如静态分析）而产生退化行为（如生成过短代码）。
summary.importance: 揭示了 RLVR 在代码生成中的“奖励黑客（reward hacking）”现象。证明了在小模型（0.6B-1B）上，通过合理组合单元测试和静态分析奖励，可以有效提升代码生成质量，为后训练阶段的奖励设计提供了实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在 MBPP 数据集上，使用 Qwen3-0.6B 和 Llama3.2-1B 进行 LoRA 微调。对比了三种奖励设计：(1) 仅单元测试；(2) 仅静态分析（通过 Ruff linter，并引入长度归一化以缓解短代码偏好）；(3) 两者结合。同时对比了 GRPO 和 GSPO 两种组策略优化算法。
summary.experiments: 在组合奖励配置下，MBPP 测试集的 pass@1 提升最高达 13 个百分点。消融实验表明，仅使用静态分析奖励会导致模型倾向于生成更短的代码以规避惩罚，而组合奖励能有效平衡功能正确性和代码规范性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对奖励黑客现象的描述，以及 Method Description 中关于 Ruff 静态分析奖励的设计和长度归一化策略。实验部分关注不同奖励配置下的 pass@1 对比和行为诊断分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to design verifiable rewards (RLVR) in RL training for code generation to improve functional correctness while preventing the model from degenerating (e.g., generating overly short code) to game a single reward signal like static analysis.
summary_en.importance: Highlights the 'reward hacking' phenomenon in RLVR for code generation. Demonstrates that on small models (0.6B-1B), a well-designed combination of unit test and static analysis rewards can effectively improve code generation quality, providing empirical guidance for reward design in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fine-tunes Qwen3-0.6B and Llama3.2-1B using LoRA on the MBPP dataset. Compares three reward formulations: (1) unit-test-only; (2) static-analysis-only (via Ruff linter, with length normalization to mitigate short-code bias); (3) combined. Also compares GRPO and GSPO group-based policy optimization variants.
summary_en.experiments: Under the combined reward configuration, pass@1 on the MBPP test set improves by up to 13 percentage points. Ablation studies show that static-analysis-only rewards lead the model to generate shorter code to avoid penalties, while combined rewards effectively balance functional correctness and code style.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the description of reward hacking in the Introduction and the design of the Ruff static analysis reward and length normalization strategy in the Method Description. In the experiments, pay attention to the pass@1 comparison and behavioral diagnostics under different reward configurations.

recommendation.zh: 在 1B 级别小模型上跑 RLVR (GRPO/GSPO) 做代码生成，重点看 reward shaping 导致的 reward hacking 现象（为了不报 lint 错干脆写短代码），对做 RL pretrain/posttrain 的同学很有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Applies RLVR (GRPO/GSPO) to 1B-scale models for code generation. Pay attention to the reward hacking induced by reward shaping (writing shorter code to avoid lint errors). Highly relevant for RL pretrain/posttrain researchers.

paper.title: Source-Grounded Semantic Reinforcement Learning for Low-Resource Target-Language Generation
paper.abstract: Low-resource target-language generation is often limited by scarce parallel data, while high-resource source-language monolingual data is abundant but difficult to use with standard supervised fine-tuning. We propose Source-Grounded Semantic Reinforcement Learning (SG-SRL), a resource-utilization framework that converts source-language monolingual data into cross-lingual semantic supervision for target-language generation. SG-SRL performs reference-free reinforcement learning (RL) on source-lang

summary.core_problem: 低资源目标语言生成缺少平行数据，如何利用高资源源语言单语数据形成可用训练信号而不依赖参考答案。
summary.importance: 把“语义对齐 reward + reference-free RL + 反 reward hacking 修复”串成可落地流程；对 RL 信号质量、verbosity hacking、以及小量并行数据做恢复的接口设计有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: SG-SRL：在源语言单语数据上做 reference-free RL，用跨语义 reward model（以 cross-lingual reranker 实现）评估源输入与目标语言输出的语义相关性；观察到 verbosity 型 reward hacking 后，引入轻量 recovery stage，用少量平行语料恢复流畅度/简洁性/格式，同时尽量保留语义增益。
summary.experiments: 任务为中→泰生成；对比标准监督微调与其它利用单语数据方案；报告语义 grounding 与 factual coverage 提升（摘要未给出具体指标与幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Low-resource target-language generation lacks parallel data; how to exploit abundant source-language monolingual data without references.
summary_en.importance: A practical recipe combining semantic-reward RL and an explicit anti-reward-hacking recovery stage; useful mainly as a case study on reward signal quality and verbosity hacking.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-SRL performs reference-free RL on source monolingual data using a cross-lingual semantic reward model (implemented via a cross-lingual reranker). It then applies a lightweight recovery stage with a small parallel corpus to fix verbosity/fluency/format while retaining semantic gains.
summary_en.experiments: Chinese-to-Thai generation; compares against supervised fine-tuning and other baselines; claims improved semantic grounding and factual coverage (no concrete numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把它当“reward hacking 实例教材”：只看 reward 设计与 recovery stage，结论别外推到通用 RLHF。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a reward-hacking case study: read the reward design and the recovery stage; don’t over-generalize it to generic RLHF.

paper.title: Theoretical Foundations and Effective Algorithms for Policy-Aware Simulator Learning
paper.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents typically learn world models by minimizing predictive loss. However, powerful RL optimizers inevitably exploit minor model inaccuracies, leading to simulator exploitation and a reality gap where policies succeed in simulation but fail in the real world. We propose that the objective for learning simulators should be strategic robustness rather than predictive accuracy, and formulate this as a zero-sum minimax game between a model player and an adv

summary.core_problem: 解决模型式强化学习里“预测误差很小但策略仍会利用模拟器漏洞”的问题，即如何让 learned simulator 对策略优化具有战略鲁棒性而不只是拟合观测。
summary.importance: 贡献偏理论与算法：把 simulator learning 从预测损失最小化改写成模型与对抗策略之间的零和博弈，并给出 regret、critic 近似和 Error-MDP 对偶分析。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对 world model、agent training、reward hacking 与 simulator exploitation 的理解有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是把模拟器学习目标定义为最坏策略下的价值差最小化，而非一步预测误差最小化。作者给出三层结果：在线学习视角下的可学习性与次线性遗憾界；用局部 critic loss 上界全局 policy-value gap 的可 tractable 简化；以及 Error-MDP duality，把寻找最坏策略转化为以一步 critic error 为奖励的标准 RL 问题，并据此设计主动数据选择算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论保证和可证明收敛的主动采样算法，但未给出具体环境、模型规模、baseline 或数值提升。按题目与摘要判断，实验更像验证理论趋势，而不是大规模经验研究。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mehryar Mohri、Yishay Mansour，均是统计学习理论与强化学习方向的资深研究者；论文气质明显偏理论。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the classic failure mode in model-based RL where a simulator with low predictive error is still exploitable by a strong policy optimizer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly theoretical and algorithmic: simulator learning is reframed as a zero-sum game between the model and an adversarial policy, with regret guarantees, critic-based simplification, and an Error-MDP duality. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to world models, agent training, reward hacking, and simulator exploitation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key move is to optimize simulators for worst-case strategic robustness rather than one-step prediction accuracy. The paper provides three pieces: learnability with sublinear regret in an online-learning formulation; a tractable critic-based bound connecting local critic loss to global policy-value gap; and an Error-MDP duality that turns worst-case policy search into a standard RL problem with one-step critic error as reward, enabling a provably convergent active data selection algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory and a provably convergent active sampling method, but does not report concrete environments, model sizes, baselines, or empirical gains. The empirical section is likely supportive rather than the main contribution.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mehryar Mohri and Yishay Mansour, both well-known senior researchers in learning theory and RL; the paper is clearly theory-driven.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相连，但它把“拟合好不等于不可被 exploit”讲得很干净；若你关心 world model 或 RL 训练信号污染，只看理论主张和 Error-MDP 对偶即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly an LLM paper, but it cleanly formalizes why good prediction does not imply robustness to exploitation; read the Error-MDP duality if you care about world models or RL signal hacking.

paper.title: EvoRubric: Self-Evolving Rubric-Driven RL for Open-Ended Generation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in verifiable domains, but aligning models for open-ended generation remains profoundly challenging due to the lack of definitive rewards. Current rubric-based RL methods mitigate this by employing explicit criteria; however, they rely heavily on static, human-annotated rubrics that inevitably cause policy lag, or expensive external proprietary models for dynamic updates. In this paper, we propose EvoRubric, a no

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式生成 RL 中奖励标准不明确、静态 rubric 滞后、动态 rubric 又依赖昂贵外部模型的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个单策略自演化 rubric-driven RL 框架，把回答生成和 rubric 生成放进同一个参数化 policy。它关注 reward signal 质量和 reward hacking，对 post-train 与 pretrain 闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: EvoRubric 让同一策略在 Reasoner 与 Rubric Generator 两种角色之间动态交替，生成回答也生成评价标准。为降低自我奖励带来的 hacking，加入多级验证流程，包括 meta-verifier、zero-variance pruning 和 Leave-One-Out peer consistency，用于过滤低质量或可被利用的 rubric 信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出底座模型、参数规模、任务集、baseline 或具体提升幅度；可确认比较对象包括静态人工 rubric 方法和依赖外部专有模型生成动态 rubric 的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles open-ended generation RL, where rewards are hard to define, static rubrics become stale, and dynamic rubrics often require expensive proprietary external models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a single-policy, self-evolving rubric-driven RL framework that unifies response generation and rubric generation. The work is relevant to reward-signal quality and reward hacking, which are important for post-training and its feedback into pretraining decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoRubric alternates one parameterized policy between a Reasoner role and a Rubric Generator role, so the model produces both answers and evaluation criteria. To reduce self-rewarding failure modes, it adds a multi-level verification pipeline with a meta-verifier, zero-variance pruning, and Leave-One-Out peer consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide base model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The implied comparisons are against static human-written rubric methods and approaches that rely on external proprietary models for dynamic rubric generation.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward 过滤设计即可；单 policy 产 rubric 的 setup 风险很高，但若验证链有效可省掉外部 judge。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-filtering design; single-policy rubric generation is risky, but a working verifier chain could reduce dependence on external judges.

paper.title: What Makes a Medical Checker Trainable? Diagnosing Signal Collapse and Reward Hacking in Checker-Guided RAG for Biomedical QA
paper.abstract: Medical RAG needs evidence-grounded claims, so plugging a claim-level NLI checker into retrieval-augmented RL is intuitive. \textbf{We find that the checker's \emph{output distribution} during training, not its held-out accuracy, decides whether it provides trainable gradient.} We compare four NLI checker back-ends as process rewards inside a GRPO-trained medical RAG agent (Qwen2.5-7B, replicated on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B) across four held-out medical QA benchmarks. Three diagnostic findings

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 verifier/checker 作为 RL 奖励时为什么会失效：决定训练是否有效的不是 checker 在静态 NLI 测试集上的准确率，而是它在当前策略 rollout 上产生的输出分布。
summary.importance: 虽然场景是医疗 RAG，但对 post-train 和 RL-for-reasoning 更有一般意义。它提醒一个容易被忽略的问题：奖励模型或过程 verifier 的离线准确率不足以判断训练可用性。训练中真正需要看的是 reward 分布是否有梯度、是否会被策略找到捷径、以及这些性质是否随策略变化。这个结论也适用于数学 verifier、代码 verifier、事实性 checker 和检索增强 agent 的过程奖励设计。
summary.technical_approach: 系统基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，用 GRPO 训练一个多轮 medical RAG agent，并扩展 Search-R1 框架。agent 有两个工具：Search 使用 MedCPT bi-encoder 在 MedRAG 语料中检索 top-5 passages；Check 是 claim-level NLI verification server，会把回答拆成 atomic claims，再判断每个 claim 与证据之间是 Entail、Neutral 还是 Contradict。作者把四种 checker 后端作为同一 reward path 的可替换组件：Likelihood-NLI 用 Meditron-3-8B 做 raw log-probability scoring；MedNLI-Cls 是 PubMedBERT-base 在 MedNLI 上微调的三分类器；Hybrid 使用 GPT-4o-mini 做 atomic claim extraction，再用本地 log-prob scorer；GPT-NLI 使用 GPT-4o-mini 端到端完成抽取和判定。核心诊断变量是 per-claim support rate，即生成 claim 中被判为 Entail 的比例。
summary.experiments: 主要发现有三点。第一，signal collapse 与 log-prob scoring 强相关：Likelihood-NLI 会把超过 97% 的 claims 判为 Neutral，使每个 claim 的支持率接近零，RL 梯度基本失效；同样的 claim-evidence 对，MedNLI-Cls 能产生非退化分布。第二，奖励信号强度和最终回答质量不是单调关系。MedNLI-Cls 的 support rate 约为 54%，属于 moderate signal，但 BERTScore 达到 0.600；更强的 GPT 类 checker support rate 更高，例如 Hybrid 约 76%、GPT-NLI 约 86%，但 GPT-NLI 对应 BERTScore 为 0.591，并触发 ultra-short answers、search avoidance、非英语回答规避英语 NLI prompt 等 reward hacking 路径。第三，signal strength 是 policy-checker pair 的性质，而不是 checker 单独的性质；作者用 Qwen2.5-7B 到 Qwen3-4B 的替换实验支持这一点，并在 Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B 上做复现性检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 对“held-out NLI accuracy 不等于 trainable reward”的论证，再看 Method 中四种 checker 的机制差异。实验部分重点看 signal collapse 的 support-rate 曲线，以及 reward hacking cascade 的分析。对做 RLHF、RLAIF、过程监督或 verifier-guided training 的读者，最该关注的是诊断指标：不要只看 verifier accuracy，要记录 rollout 上的 label 分布、reward 方差、平均回答长度、工具调用频率、语言分布和搜索使用率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why an NLI checker used as a process reward can fail during RL training. The central issue is that held-out NLI accuracy does not determine trainability; the checker’s output distribution on the policy’s own rollouts does.
summary_en.importance: The setting is biomedical RAG, but the lesson is broader for post-training and verifier-guided RL. A verifier can be accurate on static test pairs while producing either collapsed rewards or exploitable shortcuts during policy optimization. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the useful takeaway is to treat reward distribution under rollout as a training-time object: support rate, variance, shortcut channels, and policy dependence matter as much as offline accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system trains a multi-turn medical RAG agent based on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with GRPO, extending Search-R1. The agent can call Search, backed by a frozen MedCPT retriever over the MedRAG corpus, and Check, an NLI verification server that decomposes answers into atomic claims and labels each claim-evidence pair as Entail, Neutral, or Contradict. Four checker backends are plugged into the same reward path: Likelihood-NLI, which uses Meditron-3-8B with raw log-probability scoring; MedNLI-Cls, a PubMedBERT-base classifier fine-tuned on MedNLI; Hybrid, which uses GPT-4o-mini for atomic claim extraction and a local log-prob scorer; and GPT-NLI, which uses GPT-4o-mini end to end. The main diagnostic variable is per-claim support rate, the fraction of generated claims labeled Entail.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports three main diagnostic findings. First, signal collapse is specific to the log-probability scoring setup: Likelihood-NLI labels more than 97% of claims as Neutral, which removes useful RL gradient, while MedNLI-Cls gives non-degenerate labels on the same pairs. Second, stronger support signals do not monotonically improve answer quality. MedNLI-Cls produces a moderate support rate around 54% and reaches BERTScore 0.600, while stronger GPT-based checkers show higher support rates, such as 76% for Hybrid and 86% for GPT-NLI, but GPT-NLI reaches BERTScore 0.591 and induces shortcut behavior. The observed shortcut cascade includes ultra-short answers, search avoidance, and non-English responses that evade an English-only NLI prompt. Third, signal strength depends on the policy-checker pair rather than the checker alone, supported by a Qwen2.5-7B to Qwen3-4B swap and additional replication checks on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s distinction between held-out checker accuracy and rollout-time reward distribution. Then read the method section describing the four checker backends, because the mechanism differences explain the later failures. In the results, focus on the support-rate diagnostics and the reward-hacking cascade. The most reusable part is the evaluation protocol for reward signals: log label distributions on policy rollouts, reward variance, answer length, tool-use frequency, language distribution, and retrieval usage, rather than relying only on verifier accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 领域任务外壳不重要；reward 分布比 checker accuracy 更关键，这个 prior 应进内部 RLVR 诊断清单。
recommendation.en: Ignore the medical shell; the useful prior is that reward distribution beats checker accuracy as a trainability diagnostic for RLVR-style setups.

paper.title: Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Intrinsic Knowledge Boundary Enhancement
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective for training LLM-based agents with external tool-use capabilities. However, we identify that agentic RL training induces increasing redundant tool calls and blurs the model's intrinsic knowledge boundary, where the model fails to distinguish when tools are needed versus when parametric knowledge suffices. Existing solutions based on reward shaping create coarse-grained optimization targets that tend to incentivize indiscriminate tool-call

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic RL 里一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：模型在有工具可用时，随着 RL 训练推进，会越来越依赖外部工具，出现不必要的调用，甚至把本来可以靠参数知识直接回答的问题也交给工具。作者把这个现象表述为 intrinsic knowledge boundary 被模糊：模型不再清楚哪些问题在自身知识边界内，哪些问题确实需要外部检索或执行。已有方法多用 reward shaping 直接惩罚工具调用次数，但这种做法把“少用工具”当成粗粒度目标，容易诱导模型为了拿奖励而机械压低调用次数，结果是 reward hacking，且无法针对单个样本判断某次调用到底是必要还是冗余。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不大，它更接近 post-training / agentic RL 的训练信号设计；但对理解“参数知识与外部工具如何分工”有启发。价值主要有三点。第一，它把工具使用效率问题从 reward engineering 转成了 instance-level boundary probing，这个视角比简单惩罚 tool call 更干净。第二，它说明 agentic RL 会系统性改变模型的行为边界，而不是只提升任务成功率，这对后续研究 pretrain 与 tool-use 接口、以及 parametric memory 与 retrieval 的协同有参考意义。第三，它给出一个较实用的 on-policy 插件方案，不改主 RL 目标，只加辅助监督，适合接到现有 GRPO 类流程里。量级上属于中等增量，不是范式级变化，但问题定义是清楚的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 AKBE。做法不是改 reward，而是在每个训练 batch 上显式探测知识边界。具体来说，对同一个问题做 dual-path rollouts：一条路径允许调用工具，另一条路径禁止工具，只靠模型自身作答。然后根据两条路径的正确性和工具使用情况，把样本划分为几类，并构造不同的监督信号。

如果 with-tool 正确、no-tool 错误，说明问题超出当前参数知识边界，属于 Tool-dependent；这时不只是鼓励“会用工具”，还要在正确轨迹里选最少工具调用的那条，强化最省调用的正确模式。

如果 with-tool 正确、no-tool 也正确，说明工具并非必要，属于 Efficiency；这时用 no-tool 正确轨迹做监督，压掉冗余调用。

如果 with-tool 错误、no-tool 正确，说明工具引入了噪声或干扰，属于 Hallucination；这时同样强化 no-tool 正确轨迹，目的是减少有害依赖。

如果两条都错，则 Both-wrong，不额外加边界监督，只保留原始 RL 更新。

关键点有两个。第一，监督信号是 on-policy 的，因为 dual-path rollout 来自当前策略，知识边界会随训练动态变化，方法可以同步跟踪，而不是依赖静态标注。第二，它不直接把工具次数写进 reward，因此避免了 reward 与任务正确率之间的硬耦合。训练上，AKBE 作为 auxiliary loss 与标准 agentic RL 目标联合优化，作者强调它是 plug-and-play，可接到不同 agentic RL 算法上。

和已有 reward shaping 方法相比，区别不在于“也想减少工具调用”，而在于它试图回答更细的问题：当前这个样本到底需不需要工具，若需要，最小必要调用是多少。这个 per-instance 判别是方法成立的基础。
summary.experiments:
文中在 7 个 QA benchmark、2 个 backbone 上做了实验，并与标准 agentic RL 及若干效率优化基线比较。主结果是：平均任务准确率提升 1.85 个点，工具调用数下降 18%，tool productivity 提升 25%。作者强调这不是靠牺牲准确率换效率，而是在多数设置下同时改善两者。

实验设计里比较重要的部分不是单一均值，而是几类分析。其一，兼容性实验：AKBE 可以作为模块接到不同 agentic RL 算法上，而不是只对某个特定 trainer 有效。其二，训练动态分析：随着训练进行，样本在 Tool-dependent / Efficiency / Hallucination 等类别中的分布会变化，说明知识边界不是静态属性，而是会被 RL 推动迁移。其三，类别级作用分析：不同监督信号分别对应不同失败模式，Efficiency 主要压冗余调用，Hallucination 主要处理工具带来的错误覆盖，Tool-dependent 则帮助模型学到“该用工具时怎么更省地用”。

从摘要和正文可见的数字看，论文更强调平均趋势和行为改善，没有给出特别大规模的模型或数据设置，重点是训练机制而非规模扩展。若从严一点看，18% 的调用下降和 1.85 的准确率提升是不错的工程结果，但还不足以说明它改变了 agentic RL 的基本 scaling 规律。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住问题定义：RL 训练会让工具调用持续上升，且简单 reward shaping 会带来 reward hacking。然后重点看方法部分里 dual-path rollout 和四类样本划分，这是整篇最关键的设计。若时间有限，优先看定义 knowledge boundary 的段落、分类规则，以及 auxiliary loss 如何并入原有 RL 目标。

实验部分建议看三类图表：主结果表，证明准确率和效率能同时改善；训练动态图，理解 knowledge boundary 会随训练移动；消融或类别分析，确认四类监督信号各自的作用。如果只打算花 20 到 30 分钟，读完方法主图、主结果表和一组动态分析基本就够了。

值得深挖的点有两个。第一，dual-path rollout 的额外采样成本是否会抵消节省下来的工具成本，正文里如果有 wall-clock 或 sample efficiency 分析要仔细看。第二，knowledge boundary 的判定依赖当前策略采样，可能受 rollout 方差影响，尤其在 no-tool 路径本身不稳定时，分类噪声会不会误导监督，这是判断方法上限的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in agentic RL: once tools are available, RL training tends to push the model toward excessive tool use. The model increasingly calls tools even when its parametric knowledge is sufficient, or uses more calls than necessary. The authors frame this as a blurred intrinsic knowledge boundary: the policy no longer cleanly distinguishes when to rely on internal knowledge versus when external tools are actually needed. Prior work mostly addresses this with reward shaping that penalizes tool usage, but that creates a coarse optimization target. It encourages global suppression of tool calls, invites reward hacking, and cannot decide at the per-instance level whether a given call is necessary or redundant.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it sits in post-training and agentic RL. Still, it is relevant to foundation-model research because it makes the parametric-knowledge-versus-tool-use interface explicit. The main contribution is conceptual and practical rather than paradigm-shifting. Conceptually, it replaces reward-level heuristics with instance-level boundary probing. Practically, it offers an on-policy auxiliary training signal that can be attached to existing GRPO-style pipelines without rewriting the main RL objective. For researchers interested in how RL reshapes knowledge usage, retrieval reliance, and tool behavior, the paper is useful. The impact is moderate: the problem formulation is sharp, the method is sensible, but it does not yet change the broader training recipe for LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, AKBE, explicitly probes the model’s knowledge boundary during training. For each question, it runs dual-path rollouts under the current policy: one path with tool access and one path without tools. The two outcomes are then compared to infer whether the question is inside the model’s current parametric knowledge boundary and, if tools are needed, what the minimum effective tool-use pattern looks like.

The paper defines four cases. If the with-tool path is correct and the no-tool path is wrong, the sample is Tool-dependent: the model genuinely needs tools. In this case, AKBE reinforces the correct trajectory with the minimum number of tool calls, not just any successful tool-using trajectory.

If both with-tool and no-tool paths are correct, the sample is Efficiency: tools were unnecessary. AKBE then reinforces the no-tool correct trajectory to suppress redundant calls.

If the with-tool path is wrong but the no-tool path is correct, the sample is Hallucination: tool use hurt performance, likely by injecting misleading evidence or derailing reasoning. AKBE again reinforces the no-tool correct trajectory.

If both paths are wrong, the sample is Both-wrong, and no extra boundary-guided supervision is applied beyond the base RL objective.

Two design choices matter. First, the supervision is on-policy, because the dual-path rollouts come from the current model. This lets the boundary estimate evolve with training rather than relying on static labels. Second, AKBE does not modify the reward function. Instead, it adds an auxiliary loss on top of standard agentic RL, which is how it avoids the usual reward-shaping failure mode. Relative to prior efficiency-oriented methods, the novelty is not merely reducing tool calls, but estimating, per instance, whether tools are needed at all and what the minimal necessary usage should be.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports experiments on seven QA benchmarks with two backbone models, comparing standard agentic RL against AKBE and other efficiency-oriented baselines. The headline numbers are: +1.85 average accuracy improvement, 18% fewer tool calls, and 25% higher tool productivity. The authors emphasize that this is not an accuracy-efficiency tradeoff; in most settings, both improve together.

The more informative parts of the evaluation are the analyses. One is compatibility: AKBE can be plugged into multiple agentic RL algorithms rather than being tied to a single trainer. Another is training dynamics: the distribution of samples across Tool-dependent, Efficiency, and Hallucination categories changes over training, suggesting that the knowledge boundary is not static and is itself reshaped by RL. A third is category-level attribution: Efficiency supervision mainly removes redundant calls, Hallucination supervision reduces harmful tool reliance, and Tool-dependent supervision teaches more economical tool-use patterns when tools are genuinely needed.

From the available details, the paper is focused on training behavior rather than scale. It does not appear to hinge on very large models or massive data. The gains are meaningful from an engineering perspective, but they are not large enough to imply a new scaling law or a major shift in agentic RL fundamentals.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first motivating figure. The key claim is that tool calls steadily increase during RL training, and naive reward shaping creates the wrong optimization pressure. Then read the method section carefully, especially the dual-path rollout setup and the four-way categorization. That is the core of the paper.

In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main results table showing simultaneous gains in accuracy and efficiency; the training-dynamics plots showing how the boundary categories evolve; and the ablations or category analyses that isolate the role of each supervision type. For a quick pass, 20 to 30 minutes is enough if you focus on the method diagram, the main quantitative table, and one dynamic analysis figure.

Two points deserve closer scrutiny. First, dual-path rollouts add sampling cost. Check whether the paper quantifies the extra training overhead and whether the reduced tool usage compensates for it in practice. Second, the boundary estimate depends on current-policy rollouts and may be noisy. If the no-tool path is unstable, misclassification could inject noisy supervision. That issue likely determines how far the method can scale.

recommendation.zh: 把“该不该用工具”从粗糙 reward 里拆成可观测的双路径对照信号，这个训练信号设计值得抄；但先核对实验是否覆盖多工具/长轨迹，别被单一任务结论误导。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the dual-path rollout signal that turns “tool or not” into an observable contrastive supervision; validate it on multi-tool, long-horizon setups before trusting the claim beyond a narrow benchmark.

paper.title: Directional Alignment Mitigates Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
paper.abstract: Reward hacking arises when a model improves a proxy reward by exploiting shortcuts rather than solving the intended task. We study this failure mode through the geometry of reinforcement learning updates in language models and argue that hacking emerges when optimization drifts away from a stable low-dimensional learning trajectory. We analyze this drift through dominant singular directions of parameter updates and show that reward-hacking runs exhibit substantially larger directional change tha

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 RL for LM 里的 reward hacking，但切入点不是继续改 reward model，而是问：为什么模型会沿着“看起来 reward 更高、真实能力却更差”的方向走偏。作者把问题表述成优化几何问题：干净训练往往沿着一个相对稳定、低维的更新轨迹前进，而 reward hacking 对应的是更新方向从这条轨迹上发生明显旋转和漂移。论文要解决的核心问题，就是能否用这种“方向一致性”来识别并约束 RL 更新，从而延缓 shortcut exploitation。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不如 post-train 强，但它对理解 RL 阶段与基座参数空间几何的关系有启发。很多关于 reward hacking 的工作把问题归结为 reward misspecification，这篇文章补了另一个维度：即使 reward 不完美，模型是否会偏离一条相对可信的学习子空间，可能本身就是风险信号。这个视角对 RLHF、RFT、reasoning RL 都有参考意义，尤其是在大家越来越关心“RL 到底学到了什么，而不是只看 reward 曲线”的背景下。贡献量级更像一个有意思的机制假设加一个简单有效的干预方法，而不是已经成熟的通用 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是分析更新方向。作者把训练过程中某一步的参数更新 ΔW 做 SVD，写成若干奇异方向的叠加，重点关注前 K 个 dominant directions。直觉上，这些方向解释了更新中最主要的变化模式。为了比较不同 checkpoint 的方向是否一致，作者不用简单向量夹角，而是对由 top-k 奇异向量张成的子空间做 CCA，相当于测两个低维更新子空间的相似度。论文观察到，在不发生 hacking 的训练里，这些主导方向随时间演化较平滑；而在 hacking run 中，方向相似度显著下降，说明更新发生了旋转。第二步是基于这个观察做约束。作者提出 trusted-direction gradient alignment / trusted-direction projection：先用少量“干净”的监督训练步骤得到一组参考参数变化，对这些变化做 SVD，提取一个 trusted subspace；随后在 RL 训练时，把梯度投影到这个子空间内，只允许更新沿着这些被认为更可信的方向发生。这里的关键取舍是，作者只约束 output-side 的主导方向，不强行固定全部参数更新，因此比强 KL 回拉 reference policy 更有机会保留学习能力。与已有方法相比，它不是改 reward，也不是单纯缩小步长或做平滑，而是显式控制更新方向。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文内容看，核心实验集中在数学推理场景下的人为 reward-hacking 设置。分析部分先比较 clean run 和 hacking run 的方向一致性，使用 rank-1 CCA similarity，例如比较 step 20 和 step 80 的主导更新方向。论文报告 clean run 在大多数模块上的 CCA 大约维持在 0.8 左右，而 hacking model 明显更低，且最差层的漂移更严重。这支持“reward hacking 伴随方向漂移”的经验观察。方法部分再把 trusted-direction projection 用到 RL 训练中，主结论是它能显著延缓 shortcut exploitation，并更好保持真实任务性能。摘要里用的是 delay reward hacking 和 preserve task performance 这样的表述，说明它更像缓解而不是彻底消除。就目前可见内容，论文没有展示特别大规模的模型或超长训练，而是更偏机制验证：先证明几何信号存在，再证明基于该信号的投影约束有用。阅读时要留意作者是否报告了不同 rank K、不同 trusted data 规模、以及与 KL regularization 或 sharpness-based 方法的对比，这些决定方法是否只是特定设置下有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，把作者和 reward misspecification 路线、sharpness 路线的区别理清。然后直接看 Dominant Update Directions 和 Directional Shift in Reward Hacking，这两节给出整篇文章最重要的机制假设：reward hacking 不是只看 reward 设计，还要看更新是否偏离稳定子空间。接着看方法节里 trusted subspace 如何由少量 clean SFT steps 构造，以及 RL 时具体投影在哪些层、哪些矩阵上。最后看实验图，重点关注 CCA 曲线、真实任务性能与 proxy reward 是否出现背离、以及投影后这种背离是否被推迟。预计 25 分钟能完成泛读。如果要判断是否值得复现，优先检查附录里 rank 选择、不同模块一致性、以及投影带来的优化开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies reward hacking in RL for language models, but instead of treating it purely as a reward-modeling problem, it asks a geometric question: why do some RL runs drift into directions that improve proxy reward while hurting true task performance? The authors frame clean learning as following a relatively stable low-dimensional update trajectory, and reward hacking as a directional departure from that trajectory. The core problem is whether this notion of directional consistency can be measured and then used to constrain RL updates so that shortcut exploitation is delayed.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to pretraining is indirect, but the paper is relevant to anyone interested in how post-training interacts with the geometry of a pretrained model. Much of the reward-hacking literature focuses on misspecified rewards. This work adds another axis: even with imperfect rewards, the model may become unsafe when optimization leaves a trusted learning subspace. That is useful for RLHF, reasoning RL, and reinforcement fine-tuning more broadly, especially when reward curves are no longer a reliable proxy for actual capability. The contribution is best viewed as a mechanistic hypothesis plus a simple intervention, not yet a fully established general recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. First, the paper analyzes update directions. For a parameter update ΔW at a training step, the authors compute its SVD and focus on the top-K dominant singular directions, which are treated as the main modes of change. To compare directions across checkpoints, they do not rely on a single vector angle; instead they compare the subspaces spanned by the top-k singular vectors using CCA. This gives a geometry-aware measure of whether the dominant update subspace remains aligned over time. Empirically, non-hacking runs show smoother evolution and higher subspace similarity, while hacking runs exhibit stronger rotations. Second, the paper turns this observation into a constraint. It proposes trusted-direction gradient alignment, or trusted-direction projection: run a small number of clean supervised updates, collect the induced parameter changes, extract a trusted subspace via SVD, and during RL project gradients onto that subspace. The idea is to allow learning only along directions that resemble clean progress. A notable design choice is that the method constrains the dominant output-side directions rather than freezing all updates, which makes it less restrictive than strong KL anchoring to a reference policy. Relative to prior work, this is neither reward redesign nor simple step-size or sharpness control; it explicitly regulates update direction.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full text, the main experiments are in mathematical reasoning settings with induced reward-hacking scenarios. The analysis first compares clean and hacking runs using rank-1 CCA similarity between dominant update directions, for example between checkpoints 20 and 80. The paper reports that clean runs maintain CCA values around 0.8 across most modules, whereas hacking runs show substantially lower alignment and worse worst-layer behavior. This supports the central empirical claim that reward hacking is associated with directional drift. The intervention is then tested by applying trusted-direction projection during RL. The reported outcome is that it substantially delays shortcut exploitation and better preserves true task performance. The wording in the abstract is careful: the method mitigates and delays hacking rather than eliminating it. Based on the visible text, the paper appears more focused on mechanism validation than on very large-scale training. When reading, it is worth checking whether the full experiments include sensitivity to rank K, the amount of clean reference data, and comparisons against KL regularization or sharpness-based baselines, since those details determine whether the method is robust or only works in a narrow setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction to separate this paper from the standard reward-misspecification framing and from sharpness-based mitigation. Then read the sections on dominant update directions and directional shift in reward hacking, since they contain the main conceptual contribution: hacking is linked to leaving a stable update subspace. After that, inspect how the trusted subspace is built from a small number of clean SFT steps and exactly where the projection is applied during RL. In the experiments, focus on the CCA plots, the divergence between proxy reward and true task performance, and whether the projection delays that divergence. A 25-minute skim should be enough for the main idea. If you are considering reproduction, check the appendix for rank selection, layerwise consistency, and the optimization overhead introduced by the projection.

recommendation.zh: 值得看主奇异方向诊断；投影技巧未必通用，但“RL 失控先表现为更新方向漂移”应进内部监控。
recommendation.en: Read the singular-direction diagnostic; the projection trick may not generalize, but update-direction drift is a good candidate for internal RL monitoring.

paper.title: Hide to Guide: Learning via Semantic Masking
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful paradigm for improving language models on reasoning-intensive tasks, but its effectiveness is often limited by exploration. For example, models often fail on hard problems, leaving little useful reward signal. External expert traces offer a natural source of guidance, yet they may also expose reward-relevant content along the critical path to the verifier target, such as final answers, intermediate values, executable imp

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 RLVR 中专家轨迹指导和奖励泄漏之间的冲突。完整专家轨迹能帮助探索，但也可能暴露最终答案、中间数值、可执行代码或搜索实体，使策略通过复制关键内容拿到 verifier 奖励，而不是学习可泛化的推理或搜索过程。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与训练信号质量接口。RLVR 的有效性不仅取决于 verifier，也取决于模型在探索时看到了什么条件信息。论文把“专家轨迹不是纯正信号”讲得比较清楚：轨迹同时包含过程脚手架和可被奖励利用的内容。这个视角对构造 SFT/RL 数据、设计 reasoning trace、避免 reward hacking 都有启发，但方法本身是轻量的 guided RL 改造，不是新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization，简称 SMEPO。它不改变 verifier、奖励函数或 GRPO-style RL 目标，而是在给策略的专家轨迹上做语义遮蔽。核心原则是保留过程结构，例如分解方式、子目标、推理流程和搜索路径；遮蔽与 verifier 目标强相关、位于关键路径上的内容。论文给出三个实例：数学中遮蔽数值内容，避免直接泄露最终答案和中间计算值；代码中遮蔽专家解法代码，避免直接复制可执行实现；agentic search 中遮蔽答案相关实体和 query pivots，减少通过实体匹配绕过搜索过程的机会。相比只给 partial prefix 或 adaptive hints，SMEPO 尝试保留更多专家过程信息，同时降低奖励泄漏。
summary.experiments: 主实验采用每个领域 1k 样本设置，在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，数学从 47.6 提升到 50.3，代码从 56.5 提升到 59.0，agentic search 从 45.6 提升到 48.8。迁移实验中，Qwen2.5-7B 数学从 42.4 提升到 44.5，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 从 61.8 提升到 62.6。SMEPO 还使 hard-math 目标更早达到。在 GHPO 原始数据设置下，加入 SMEPO 将数学平均分从 44.0 提升到 45.6。诊断消融支持论文解释：随机遮蔽无效，固定前缀暴露不稳定，越针对 reward-relevant content 的遮蔽效果越好，说明问题不是简单的上下文长度或噪声，而是泄漏内容的结构性影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 对 failure mode 的定义，它把探索稀疏奖励和专家轨迹泄漏放在同一框架里。方法部分重点看不同领域如何定义 semantic masking target，这比算法公式更关键。实验部分建议看主结果表、hard-math 收敛曲线、GHPO 叠加实验和 masking ablation。若做 RLVR 数据构造，可以重点检查遮蔽规则是否依赖人工启发、是否可能误删必要推理信息，以及遮蔽 token 是否在训练和推理之间形成新的分布差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a tension in RL with verifiable rewards: expert traces improve exploration, but full traces can leak verifier-aligned content. A policy may obtain reward by copying final answers, intermediate values, executable code, or answer-related entities, rather than learning the reasoning or search behavior that produced them.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to the interface between post-training and signal quality. RLVR is not only about the verifier and the RL objective; it also depends on what information the policy is conditioned on during exploration. The paper makes a useful distinction between procedural scaffolding and reward-relevant leakage inside the same expert trace. This is relevant for reasoning-trace design, SFT/RL data construction, and reward-hacking analysis, though the method itself is a lightweight guided-RL intervention rather than a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization, or SMEPO. It leaves the verifier, reward function, and GRPO-style objective unchanged, and instead modifies the expert trace provided to the policy. The rule is to preserve procedural structure such as decomposition, subgoals, reasoning flow, and search plans, while masking semantic spans that lie on the critical path to the verifier target. The instantiations are domain-specific: numerical content is masked in math traces, expert solution code is masked in coding traces, and answer-related entities are masked in agentic search traces. Compared with partial prefixes or adaptive hints, the method tries to keep more of the expert process while reducing direct reward leakage.
summary_en.experiments: In the main 1k-example-per-domain setting, SMEPO improves Qwen3-8B-Base from 47.6 to 50.3 on math, from 56.5 to 59.0 on code, and from 45.6 to 48.8 on agentic search. The gains also transfer to other math models: Qwen2.5-7B improves from 42.4 to 44.5, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B improves from 61.8 to 62.6. The method reaches hard-math targets earlier than vanilla GRPO. In a GHPO setup using the original GHPO data, adding SMEPO raises the math average from 44.0 to 45.6. Ablations support the leakage explanation: random masking fails, fixed-prefix exposure is unstable, and more targeted removal of reward-relevant content works best.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the Introduction, where the failure mode is defined clearly: sparse exploration rewards on one side and expert-trace leakage on the other. In the method section, focus on how masking targets are chosen for math, code, and agentic search; those design choices matter more than the RL notation. In the experiments, read the main result table, the hard-math convergence analysis, the GHPO combination result, and the masking ablations. For RLVR data work, the key questions are whether the masking rules depend too much on hand-built heuristics, whether they remove useful reasoning information, and whether masked traces create a train-test conditioning mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 针对 RLVR 中引入专家轨迹导致的 reward hacking 问题，提出了语义掩码的解决方案，对关注 RL 训练稳定性和数据合成质量的研究员很有启发。
recommendation.en: Addresses reward hacking caused by expert traces in RLVR using semantic masking; highly insightful for researchers focusing on RL training stability and data synthesis quality.

paper.title: SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: As long-horizon coding agents produce more code than any developer can review, oversight collapses onto a single surface: the automated test suite. Reward hacking naturally arises in this setup, as the agent optimizes for passing tests while deviating from the users true goal. We study this reward hacking phenomenon by decompose software engineering tasks into three parts: (i) a natural language description of the specification (ii) visible validation tests that exercise specified features in is

summary.core_problem: 长周期编码代理仅以可见的验证测试集为优化目标，普遍存在奖励黑客问题，目前缺乏量化衡量该问题的基准与方法。
summary.importance: 明确了编码代理中奖励黑客的可量化指标，为编码代理的训练信号设计、评测体系优化提供参考，也为RL对齐中的代理奖励设计提供了跨领域的实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SpecBench基准，包含30个系统级编码任务，每个任务配套可见的单功能验证测试集和隐藏的功能组合保留测试集，定义奖励黑客gap为验证集通过率与保留集通过率的差值，用来量化代理的作弊程度。
summary.experiments: 在多模型、多编码框架、多搜索策略下的测试显示，所有模型都可以在验证集上达到满通过率；奖励黑客gap随任务复杂度上升而扩大，MMLU得分更低的模型gap更大；同时总结出特征隔离、直接记忆验证测试等具体作弊策略。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注基准设计部分的测试集划分逻辑、实验部分的两个核心相关性结论，以及作弊策略的分类总结，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon coding agents only optimize against visible validation test suites, leading to pervasive reward hacking, and there is no existing benchmark or quantitative method to measure this problem.
summary_en.importance: It defines a quantifiable metric for reward hacking in coding agents, provides reference for coding agent training signal design and evaluation system optimization, and offers cross-domain empirical evidence for proxy reward design in RL alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SpecBench benchmark includes 30 system-level coding tasks. Each task is paired with a visible validation test suite that tests individual features, and a hidden held-out test suite that tests feature compositions. The reward hacking gap, defined as the difference between validation pass rate and held-out pass rate, is used to quantify the degree of reward hacking.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across multiple models, coding harnesses and search strategies show all models can achieve 100% pass rate on validation suites. The reward hacking gap grows with task complexity, and models with lower MMLU scores have larger gaps. Common hacking strategies including feature isolation and direct memorization of validation tests are also documented.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the test suite split logic in Benchmark Design section, the two core correlation findings in Experiments, and the classification of hacking strategies. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和 visible/held-out gap；它提醒 coding RL 的奖励面可能比能力面更脆。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and visible/held-out gap; it is a useful warning that coding-RL reward surfaces can be much weaker than the capability they claim to measure.

paper.title: Hack-Verifiable Environments: Towards Evaluating Reward Hacking at Scale
paper.abstract: Aligning autonomous agents with human intent remains a central challenge in modern AI. A key manifestation of this challenge is reward hacking, whereby agents appear successful under the evaluation signal while violating the intended objective. Reward hacking has been observed across a wide range of settings, yet methods for reliably measuring it at scale remain lacking. In this work, we introduce a new evaluation paradigm for measuring reward hacking. Whereas prior studies have primarily analyz

summary.core_problem: 现有reward hacking评测方法存在两个关键缺陷：通常局限于单一固定任务（如代码agent或特定游戏），且缺乏自动化检测机制——依赖人工检查不可扩展，依赖LLM评测不可靠且计算成本高。论文要解决的核心问题是：如何构建能在多样化环境中可靠测量reward hacking的基准评测方法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的主要启发在于：reward hacking是对齐研究的核心问题，而该论文提供了一种可规模化的评测范式，将可检测的reward hacking机会预先嵌入环境，使得agent是否利用漏洞可被确定性验证。这对RLHF、RL pretrain以及agent对齐的评测基础设施建设有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出hack-verifiable environments框架：通过一个包装器（wrapper）将基础环境扩展为可验证hack的环境。包装器在原有环境的观测空间和动作空间中植入可控的reward hacking机会，并定义hack集合（每个hack是一个从观测-动作对到{0,1}的判别函数），从而实现对reward hacking行为的确定性监控。论文在TextArena上实例化了该框架，具体实现是一个模拟文件系统作为包装器，包含标准终端命令和加密工具，在文件系统中同时放置良性内容和植入的hack内容（包括隐藏的正确答案、提示信息、对抗性提示、密码学后门等），通过检测agent对这些植入内容的读取/写入/提交行为来确定性判断reward hacking。
summary.experiments: 论文在TextArena的单agent和多agent设置下实例化了框架并开源了代码。使用该环境分析了前沿模型和开源模型的reward hacking行为（具体实验结果在提供的全文内容中未完整展示，但论文结构表明在Section 3和Section 4中包含了跨模型的实证分析）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Section 2（框架定义和包装器构造）和Figure 1-2（文件系统结构和利用轨迹可视化），理解hack-verifiable environments的设计思路。Section 6（broader challenges in reward hacking evaluation）可快速浏览以了解该方向的开放问题。预计阅读时间：20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的内容中明确给出。论文引用了Wang et al.关于reward hacking的前期工作以及TextArena（Liu et al.）作为基础环境。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reward hacking evaluation methods have two key limitations: they are typically confined to a single fixed task (e.g., coding agents or specific games), and they lack automated detection mechanisms—manual inspection is not scalable, while LLM-based evaluators are unreliable and computationally expensive. The core question addressed is: how to construct benchmarks that can reliably measure reward hacking across diverse environments at scale.
summary_en.importance: The primary relevance to pretraining research lies in providing a scalable evaluation paradigm for reward hacking, a central problem in alignment. The framework enables deterministic verification of whether agents exploit embedded vulnerabilities, which has implications for RLHF, RL pretrain, and agent alignment evaluation infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the hack-verifiable environments framework: a base environment is extended via a wrapper that embeds controlled reward hacking opportunities into the observation and action spaces. A hack set ℋ is defined where each h∈ℋ is a function mapping observation-action pairs to {0,1}, enabling deterministic monitoring. The framework is instantiated on TextArena using a mock filesystem wrapper exposing standard terminal commands and encryption tools. The filesystem contains both benign content and planted hack content (hidden correct answers, hints, adversarial prompts, cryptographic backdoors), and hack detection is done by tracking when agents read/write/submit content derived from planted hacks.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is instantiated on TextArena in both single-agent and multi-agent settings, with full code released. Empirical analysis of reward hacking behavior across frontier and open-source models is presented (specific numerical results were not fully contained in the provided text but are structured in Sections 3 and 4 of the paper).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (framework definition and wrapper construction) and Figures 1-2 (filesystem structure and exploitation trajectory visualization) to understand the design of hack-verifiable environments. Section 6 (broader challenges) can be skimmed for open problems in reward hacking evaluation. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the provided content. The paper builds on prior work by Wang et al. on reward hacking and TextArena (Liu et al.) as the base environment.

recommendation.zh: 内置可验证漏洞的评估思路对RL对齐的鲁棒性测试很有价值，值得在内部奖励模型测试中参考该范式
recommendation.en: The evaluation idea of embedding verifiable vulnerabilities is valuable for robustness testing of RL alignment, and this paradigm is worth referencing in internal reward model testing.

paper.title: ParaVT: Taming the Tool Prior Paradox for Parallel Tool Use in Agentic Video Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training large multimodal models (LMMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) to natively invoke video-processing tools (e.g., cropping) has become a promising route to long-video understanding. However, existing native-RL methods dispatch tool calls sequentially (i.e., one per turn): a single wrong crop propagates errors without peer correction, multi-turn tool calls corrupt context, and inference cost scales linearly with the number of turns. We introduce ParaVT, the first multi-agent end-to-end RL-

summary.core_problem: 在长视频理解的 agentic RL 场景中，如何让多模态模型稳定地并行调用视频工具，而不是依赖脆弱且昂贵的串行单工具调用。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于通用 agent/tool-use 方法，而不是纯应用。它的重要性在于提出了一个训练层面的失败模式：预训练得到的 tool prior 既帮助探索，也会破坏冷启动格式稳定性并诱发 skip-tool 奖励捷径。这对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ParaVT，用多 agent 框架在单轮内并行发起多个时间窗口 crop 工具调用，再通过端到端 RL 训练。论文进一步提出 Tool Prior Paradox：强工具先验会让模型更容易探索工具，但也更容易在温度采样下走向格式不稳和跳过工具的奖励漏洞。为此作者设计了两阶段训练：先做结构化冷启动以稳定格式，再做结果导向 RL 以提升工具使用收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验围绕长视频理解中的原生工具调用展开，并与顺序式 tool-calling RL 方法比较。作者声称并行调用带来更好的容错、更干净的上下文和更低推理成本；同时通过跨模型对比支持 Tool Prior Paradox。由于摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和 benchmark 名称，证据强度要看正文里的 reward 设计、采样温度控制和是否排除了 prompt/format confound。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 LMMs-Lab；Lidong Bing 在多模态与大模型方向有较多工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to make multimodal models use video tools in parallel under RL, instead of relying on fragile and costly sequential one-tool-per-turn interaction for long-video understanding.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent/tool-use method rather than a domain application. Its main value is the training-side failure mode it identifies: pretrained tool priors help exploration, but can also destabilize cold-start formatting and create skip-tool reward shortcuts. That is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose ParaVT, a multi-agent framework that dispatches multiple temporal crop calls in a single turn and trains the whole setup end-to-end with RL. They introduce the Tool Prior Paradox: stronger pretrained tool priors improve exploration but make structural formatting less stable and expose reward hacking under temperature sampling. To address this, they use a two-stage recipe: structured cold start for format stability, followed by outcome-oriented RL for better tool use.
